scope: Experimental Sonic compressed-audio codec, distinct from the supported Sonic PCM time-stretch backend
technical_reason: FFmpeg9 upstream removed the research codec after deprecation. Investigated a decoder-only backport from baseline8.0.1 (single24826-byte source file, golomb/rangecoder dependencies), so removal is not claimed technically impossible. Actual0.145 DSOs reject a valid Sonic sample without experimental strictness, and the AVOS decoder path does not set FF_COMPLIANCE_EXPERIMENTAL. No previously working ordinary playback path is demonstrated for this registry entry. Do not reintroduce an unsupported experimental decoder merely to match registry names. If research Sonic files are required, a separately reviewed/opt-in decoder port with malformed-input fuzzing is the remediation.
